node.title: Every fixed rate-half two-petal background cell has codimension at least ell-1
node.statement: For a rate-half M=4,t=2 cell with d=ell+s and exact background set R of size r>=s, the guarded cofactor congruence has locator dimension at most 2s+2-min(r,s+1). Hence every nonempty monic degree-d chart has affine codimension at least ell-1; when r=s its dimension is exactly s+2 and codimension exactly ell-1, while r>=s+1 gives codimension at least ell. Aggregated without choosing R, contributors lie in one joint locus where F is split on the core and its uniquely reconstructed W_F has at least s background roots. A per-R union bound is not claimed.
